what_happened: Layout 8, green bendy Straw012, GlassCup025. Stage 0 slow (310, p90 202): closes on air at 243/263/308 before the drawer was dragged open 272-320. Straw: close on air 459, grasp 483-493, lifted 0.63 m (width 0.009), navigation 494-~850. From ~960 to ~1260 (~300 steps) the straw was held near the cup and re-positioned around it; it touched the cup only 1223-1225 and 1229-1231. ~1260-1320 the arm lifted away still holding the straw, held it elsewhere until 1517, and released it 0.23 m from the cup; it fell to the floor (end z 0.007).
causal_chain: at the cup by ~960 (time enough) -> ~300 steps of hovering/re-positioning with two brief rim contacts -> carried the straw away -> released 23 cm off over the edge (1517) -> straw on the floor
official_criterion_notes: Official success = straw touches the cup AND straw centre < 0.5 m horizontally from the cup centre AND gripper far; there is no 'inside' or upright test, so a straw lying across the rim or leaning on the outside of the cup would count once the gripper leaves.
